$comment: Device space: model px, bottom of the device at y = 0, front plate at z = 1.75, front faces -z (toward the player).

rack_console.requires: rack front door open; right-click the console (or its U) - again, or walking > 4 blocks away / closing the door, reverses

parts.body: rack_device/rack_console (static, its front is the dark drawer opening)
parts.drawer: rack_device/rack_console_drawer(_on|_fault)  - front plate + tray, carries the status LED glow
parts.lid: rack_device/rack_console_lid(_on) - the fold-up screen; _on adds the emissive screen when open and online

rack_console.close: the reverse: lid 100 -> 0 deg over 6 ticks (hinge click at start), then drawer back over 8 ticks (console_slide_in)
rack_console.screen: lid_on (emissive, animated console_screen.png) only while the lid is past 60 deg and the network is online

tape_library.window: picker drawn by the device render extra in front of the magazine (z 1.69-1.70, texel space)

sprites.carriage: (60, ex)-(68, ex+2) on the rail at y = 2
sprites.head: (60, ex)-(68, ex+6)
sprites.cable: 2 px wide strip from the carriage down to the head (chassis texel)
sprites.ex: 64 for the 4U sheet, 128 for the 6U sheet

path: home: head at (62, 4) parked by the vertical guide x = 66
move X along the rail to the target column (slot x + -2)
drop Y to the slot row
grab: 4 ticks (tape sprite hides from the slot and is drawn on the head)
move X to x = 66 (the drive chute at the window edge)
drop to the drive level (bottom of the window), insert: 4 ticks
tape_library.rear: the drive sled in that bay shows its reading (blue) or writing (amber) LED while the tape is in it
